promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-15 (miso-159) BY THE SESSION'S OWN PRE-REGISTERED DECISION RULE — the PREREG's §7(a) condition was met exactly, so no owner escalation was needed (the first MISO promotion since miso-127 not to require one): the arm's fail set is a STRICT SUBSET of the predecessor's ({C3a-2025, C3b-2025} -> {C3a-2025}) and NO criterion-year that passes in the control fails in the arm. MISO keeper -> 2026-08-15-miso-159-cod-vintage (bundle results/calibration/miso159_cod_B). THE SINGLE DELTA against the predecessor 2026-08-09-miso-148-basis-aware is ONE ScenarioConfig field, commission_year_cod_fallback=true, applied via replay_keeper --set through the generic prb_overrides channel and recorded verbatim in run_config.json (rule 24 [R-REGISTRY]); scored against a SAME-HEAD ZERO-DELTA CONTROL (2026-08-15-miso-159-control, bundle miso159_cod_A), never against the committed predecessor (the miso-124 DO-NOT-MISREAD) — and this time the control reproduces the committed keeper EXACTLY at the gated grain (C3a -2.0/-8.0/-15.6 %, C3b NRMSE 0.082/0.125/0.212, every verdict identical), so no K0-class drift is carried. WHAT IT IS. miso-157 §7 root-caused (via trap T-3 on an exact 0.0700 constant) that assembly.py::_commission_year looks every plant up in master-plant-registry.csv — an ERCOT-only file, 833 rows all ba_code='ERCO' — and falls through to a HARDCODED return 2010, so MISO's ENTIRE 108.70 GW plant-group-tagged thermal fleet carried online_year=2010 and the age-escalation limb of THERMAL_AVAILABILITY (WEFOR +w_rate/yr past onset; DERATE +d_rate/yr past onset) was IDENTICALLY INERT: 0.000 GW past onset in every class in every training year, against true cap-weighted vintages of 1976.8 (ST_GAS) to 2006.5 (CC_REGULAR) measured at 100.0% EIA-860 capacity coverage. The miso-158 census (PR #3966) discharged the rule-25 scoping prerequisite: the same total registry miss holds for CAISO/PJM/NYISO/NEISO (hit share 0.0%), ERCOT is covered at 99.7% and moves EXACTLY 0.000 GW under the fall-through-only replacement. THE REPAIR is a boolean gate routing the fall-through through cod_ramp.load_cod_map() — the repo's single COD source, the capacity-weighted per-plant EIA-860 (Operating Year, Operating Month) reduction that ALREADY drives every backcast's monthly online mask — BEFORE the 2010 literal, with precedence otherwise unchanged (curated coal dict, then the master registry, then the COD map, then a disclosed 2010 for the 0.0-0.6% of capacity absent from both sources). ZERO CONTINUOUS DEGREES OF FREEDOM (rule 21 [R-DOF]): no tunable year, per-class scale or sweepable tolerance, and no parameterised variant was built or solved; the free-parameter ledger is UNCHANGED (30 entries / 2 residual). Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]: mask and age model now read ONE measured record. Rule 13/14 forward story: EIA-860 CODs regenerate for any forward vintage and respond to fleet turnover. WHAT IT REMOVES, measured on the production arrays (Phase-0 instrument, _miso159_cod_vintage_instrument.json): 2.13/2.46/2.87 GW of phantom ANNUAL capability and 1.31/1.48/1.64 GW of phantom Jun-Sep capability (non-CHP; 2025 by class: COAL 1.294/0.689, CT_PEAKER 0.800/0.462, ST_GAS 0.676/0.427 GW annual/summer) — the census-derived P-1 bands MISSED LOW and the miss is attributed in the record (coal's summer availability carries no WEFOR under coal_drop_pof, so its summer leg moves on DERATE alone; the census weighted nameplate where the LP prices net-summer pmax). Phase-0 gates: V2 off-path byte-inert PASS (flip-guard 9/9, default cache key unmoved); S-CACHE distinct-key PASS; V3 keeper fleet PASS (n_gen 2929/2923/2923, 6 carry zones, both arms); V1 PASS ON ATTRIBUTION after S-V1 fired and was debugged per the miso-157 §3 protocol (CT_CHP +1.015 yr on the LP-pmax basis is the BTM steam-following holdout's weighting; +0.011 yr on the census's own nameplate basis; every non-CHP class ≤0.12 yr on both bases; unit tests TestCommissionYearCodFallback 4/4). WHAT IT DOES AT THE GATES, all deltas arm-vs-control: demand-weighted prices rise +0.635/+0.837/+1.123 $/MWh (+1.97/+2.82/+2.93%) — UP in all three years exactly as the PREREG's P-2 disclosed IN ADVANCE (the repair removes capability, so its price direction is toward the failing gates, and per the PREREG none of the improvement is quoted as calibration skill; adoption is on rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE] structural fidelity — a measured input replacing a rule-5 magic literal on the price-setting fleet). C3a: -2.0/-8.0/-15.6 % -> -0.1/-5.4/-13.1 % — 2023 lands at essentially ZERO error (the +1.97% lift stayed under the pre-computed +3% against-interest bound, so S-2023 never fired), 2024 improves 2.6 pp, 2025 improves 2.5 pp and STILL FAILS its ±10% gate at -13.1% (reported at full magnitude; the summer-peak identity object miso-156 measured remains the standing blocker). C3b NRMSE: 0.082/0.125/0.212 -> 0.080/0.113/0.200 — the 2025 shape criterion FLIPS FAIL->PASS, recovering the regression the miso-148 promotion accepted, AT THE GATE EXACTLY (0.200 vs ≤0.200 — reported as knife-edge, never as margin). C3c stays the ledgered model-class caveat (2024 4h->5h, 2025 0h->1h of >$200 RT hours — marginally toward the actual 37/88, immaterial); C1 16/16, C2, C4, C6 (attested), C8 all PASS with no new forcing id. Determination NOT-YET on C3a-2025 ALONE — the fail set is the smallest any MISO keeper has carried. Rule 22 [R-HOLDOUT]: 2023-2025 only, both arms, one invocation each; MISO holds neither complete nor final and the spend freeze is ACTIVE. Rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: MISO armed only; ERCOT/CAISO/PJM/NYISO/NEISO cells enter U with the census citations and each lane measures its own before arming. LOYO (rule 22): zero fitted parameters, nothing year-specific — the predicate is each plant's own published COD — and the effect is same-signed 3/3 in every channel (capability down, prices up, C3a toward zero). Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-miso159-commission-year-cod-repair-2026-08-15.md; PREREG-miso159-commission-year-cod-fallback-2026-08-15.md @ fdb099f blob 77b76622 (pushed and byte-verified BEFORE the construction was built); probe scripts/probes/_miso159_cod_vintage_instrument.py; record _miso159_cod_vintage_instrument.json.
note:
THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-159): MISO's thermal fleet is no longer uniformly stamped vintage 2010. The ERCOT-only master plant registry misses every MISO plant, and _commission_year's hardcoded 2010 fall-through had made the entire age-escalation limb of THERMAL_AVAILABILITY inert — 108.70 GW carried as 13-15 years old when the fleet's true cap-weighted vintages run 1976.8 (ST_GAS) to 2006.5 (CC_REGULAR). The new zero-DOF boolean routes the fall-through through the measured capacity-weighted EIA-860 COD map (the same single source that already drives the monthly online mask), removing 2.9 GW of phantom annual capability and 1.6 GW of phantom summer capability in 2025, concentrated in COAL / CT_PEAKER / ST_GAS — the classes that set MISO's summer and shoulder prices. Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control the repair lifts demand-weighted prices +1.97/+2.82/+2.93% (direction disclosed in advance; not claimed as skill), takes C3a to -0.1/-5.4/-13.1% (2023 at essentially zero error; 2025 still failing at -13.1%), and FLIPS C3b-2025 back through its 0.200 gate (0.212 -> 0.200 exactly — knife-edge, reported as such), recovering the shape regression the miso-148 promotion accepted. Determination NOT-YET on C3a-2025 alone — the smallest fail set any MISO keeper has carried. Promoted BY THE PRE-REGISTERED RULE (fail set strict subset + no criterion-year flip), the first MISO promotion since miso-127 to clear its own PREREG condition without owner escalation.

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-148): MISO no longer derates its gas fleet for summer ambient loss TWICE. The flat _SUMMER_CLASS_DERATE (CC 10 %, CT 12.5 %) IS the nameplate -> summer-peak ambient loss, but MISO's per-plant pmax is ALREADY the published EIA-860 net-summer rating, which embeds that loss -- so the model was removing it a second time, 5.7-5.9 GW of summer h12-17 capability (miso-141, which also refuted the 'incremental loss' reading: the honest incremental is an UPRATE, sign inverted in 18 of 18 zone-years). The new class-agnostic flag applies the flat derate ONLY to units still carried on a nameplate basis, KEEPS it for corrupt-filing plants the always-on CC guard clips onto a nameplate-like bound (86.9 % of MW admitted; 7,255 MW kept across 9 CC + 4 CT plants), and changes nothing else -- no POF or age-derate drop, no WEFOR change, no capacity rescale, no off-summer leg. ZERO free parameters. CT_PEAKER, which had NO mechanism at all and the largest measured gap, is the biggest single contributor (2,551 MW in 2025). WHAT IT REPAIRS: monthly AV_CC - A_CC in Jun-Sep 2025 moves -2,296 / -2,451 / -2,157 / -1,560 MW -> -373 / -369 / -77 / +419 MW, so model available CC capability no longer sits BELOW reality's observed CC generation -- availability below observed output is indefensible for any outage input. Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control the restored CC runs (2023 CC_REGULAR +3.16 TWh) and displaces COAL_PRB, imports and ST_GAS, exactly the composition defect miso-147 measured. THE COST IS REAL AND IS KEPT: C3a -0.49 / -6.01 / -14.15 % -> -1.98 / -8.03 / -15.58 %, worse in every year, and C3b-2025 NRMSE 0.192 -> 0.212 crosses its 0.200 gate, so the fail set grows to {C3a, C3b}; ST_GAS forced share rises +2.4 / +2.8 / +3.7 pp with C8 still passing and grounded. Determination stays NOT-YET. The downward price direction was disclosed BEFORE the solve, and nothing here is offered as progress against the 2025 level miss. Promoted on structural fidelity under rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE] by explicit OWNER DECISION -- the session escalated rather than promoted, because its own PREREG conditioned promotion on the fail set staying a subset of {C3a}. A CORRECTION ANY SUCCESSOR MUST CARRY: the mechanism moves prices in Jun-Sep and nowhere else, so MAY IS NOT REACHABLE BY IT (+12.43 % -> +12.41 %) -- May and summer are the same symptom with different causes, and the May half is still unexplained.

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-132(b)): MISO's CC committed (min-stable-load) offer bands are now priced at the fleet's own measured min-load block-average burn -- avg_committed_p50 = 1.005 (n=103 CC units, cap-weighted, CAMPD 2023-2025) -- instead of a generic 1.20 part-load premium (CC_REGULAR) and a generic 0.92 default (the cc_intermediate_split-routed bulk) that the code's own comment calls 'an unphysical, artificially-cheap min-load block'. One measured value replaces two ungrounded multipliers for the same physical quantity; both cohorts move together so no direction is chosen; zero free parameters, no re-derive, markup lands at 0 under the armed gas_offer_margin. This is the same grounding CT_PEAKER's committed band already carries at MISO and the same measured-conduct-over-generic-multiplier move that closed ERCOT's offer surface. Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control the re-priced committed block runs less overnight (CC_REGULAR -1.61/-0.96/-1.50 TWh), the July night floor lifts +0.32/+0.01/+0.11 $/MWh, and C7 COAL_PRB cv_ratio slips -0.009/-0.005/-0.009 (2025 0.347 -> 0.338) with profile_r preserved -- the PREREG's pre-accepted two-sided prior: the regression is a discovered-bug signal sharpening miso-130's overnight-supply root cause, never grounds to revert to the ungrounded values. Nothing regresses at the gated grain: determination NOT-YET, caveats {C3a, C3c}, every criterion and diagnostic verdict identical to control; all blocking A/B gates PASS and the single K8 R_tot-floor FAIL is inherited from the control's own 2024 baseline (0.8770 < 0.90), not caused by the arm (moves <=0.003). Promoted on structural fidelity under rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE] per the pre-declared PREREG decision rule and explicit owner confirmation.

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-127): MISO's coal must-run band is now sized by the measured ONLINE minimum stable load rather than an all-hours available-CF P5 that only proxies it. The cheap, fuel-sunk tranche shrinks or grows per plant to the net MW the unit actually holds 95 % of the time it is synchronized; capacity leaving it enters the full-delivered-cost tranches and price-follows. The headline is that this is NOT the small change the fleet aggregate suggests: capacity-weighted the two columns differ by only 0.956x (-533 MW), but that net hides 7,528 MW GROSS -- 18 % of the coal fleet -- moving in OPPOSITE directions on 39 of 44 plants, which is why it was solved instead of declared inert. Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control it moves C7 COAL_PRB -- MISO's sole failing criterion -- in ALL THREE years, crossing the gate in two: cv_ratio 0.465 -> 0.514, 0.474 -> 0.529, 0.314 -> 0.347, with profile_r preserved, so the model finally recovers overnight-to-midday AMPLITUDE it was missing rather than trading phase for it. C7 still FAILS on 2025 and the determination stays NOT-YET. Both of miso-102's failure modes are absent: C1 holds 16/16 and COAL_BIT does not overshoot. Summed C1 |error| improves 35.46 -> 30.48 TWh, with COAL_PRB's own error collapsing 3.81 -> 0.57 TWh; C3a under-pricing narrows (-1.4/-6.6 % -> -1.0/-6.3 %), C3b and C4 both improve, and no criterion status regresses. ZERO free parameters -- the flag is a boolean selector between two columns already committed in thermal_tranches_MISO.csv, and no re-derive was performed. Promoted on structural fidelity under rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE].

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-126): MISO's fleet now contains a 250 MW combined-cycle STEAM turbine it had been silently dropping. EIA-860 55088 Dearborn ST1 -- prime mover CA, Unit Code SINT shared with the two NG CT turbines whose exhaust drives it, Energy Source 1 BFG -- is half of an ordinary gas-fired combined cycle, but EIA-860's Energy Source 1 on a CA row describes the block's SUPPLEMENTARY/DUCT fuel rather than its primary energy input, so the fuel-type map returned None and the row never reached the LP. The plant ran at 515.0 MW against a published 765.0 MW. The heat rate needed no change and got none: eGRID's own PLNGENAN implies a physically impossible 116.6 % capacity factor on 515 MW and a plausible 78.5 % on 765 MW, so the measured CHP rate was ALREADY a block rate charged to two thirds of the block. Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control the restored machine adds CC_CHP +1,013.7/+1,149.7/+1,073.3 GWh in 2023/2024/2025, displacing CT_PEAKER, CC_REGULAR, COAL_PRB, imports and ST_GAS, at max zonal |dLMP| 18.578/1.328/12.267 $/MWh and a one-sided system demand-weighted -0.0805/-0.0812/-0.1005 $/MWh. C1 CC_CHP error collapses -1.55 -> -0.53 and -1.61 -> -0.46 TWh (68 %/71 % of the class's whole error) because the EIA-923 benchmark target always counted this machine's output; summed C1 |error| improves 37.20 -> 35.46 TWh. Every criterion verdict, the determination and the ledgered caveats are IDENTICAL to the predecessor, with zero legitimacy-diagnostic changes. ZERO free parameters: the predicate is equalities on published EIA-860 categorical fields plus one physical vintage inequality (a heat-recovery steam generator is not older than the turbines that drive it), and the restored unit takes the block's existing rate. 50973 Motiva's 40.4 MW is deliberately NOT included -- a pre-registered falsifier and the vintage clause independently exclude it -- and 1004 Edwardsport, already represented as COAL 555.0 MW, is untouched. Promoted on structural fidelity under rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE], never on a score.

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-124): MISO's oil/gas switch-capable fleet is now priced the way the market prices it -- a unit flagged Multifuel on EIA-860 burns whichever fuel is cheaper, so its delivered price is min(gas, oil). The cap reaches 371 / 371 / 369 gas tranches (15,827 / 15,827 / 15,825 MW = 23.3 % of MISO gas) in 2023 / 2024 / 2025, with the parity price taken from 12/12 measured MISO F923 Petroleum months in every year (20.36 / 18.22 / 17.21 $/MMBtu -- the flat national fallback is never reached). ZERO free parameters: both legs are published measured registries and the mechanism is the arithmetic min() of them, with no coefficient between. It is INERT at every scored grain and that is the expected, measured result, not a failure: CAMPD's own meters put observed MISO dual-fuel oil generation at ~0.002 % of ISO energy, so the real phenomenon is too small to move an ISO-level annual criterion. Every criterion verdict, the determination and the ledgered caveats are IDENTICAL to the predecessor 2026-08-04-miso-122b-scope-gate; the whole price effect is 6 hours of mid-January 2024 (max zonal |dLMP| 1.383 $/MWh, system demand-weighted -0.000159), one-sided downward as a min() cap requires, and ~0.0003 TWh of class energy. Armed on rule 1 [R-STRUCT] structural fidelity under an explicit owner call, restoring an arming that miso-121 established and a merge race dropped.

THIS KEEPER'S OWN DELTA (miso-122): MISO's topping-cycle CHP plants are priced on a heat rate that no longer charges direct-fired host-process fuel to their power tranches. eGRID publishes ONE CHP heat-input split per PLANT, which cannot see a HYBRID cogen -- a topping CC/CT train plus a package boiler on the same ORIS code -- so plant 55088 Dearborn passed the derive's 0.50 unfired-topping ceiling on a plant-average thermal_share of 0.2396 while 16.6 % of its metered fuel burned in three 'Other boiler' units reporting ZERO gross load all year. CAMPD/CEMS resolves that at UNIT grain, and the derive now removes it: heat_rate = (PLHTIAN + CHPCHTI) * (1 - dark_fuel_share) / PLNGENAN. A SHARE, never an MMBtu subtraction, so it needs CEMS's fuel COMPOSITION to be representative and never CEMS's LEVEL to equal eGRID's; the denominator is unchanged, zero free parameters, no threshold, byte no-op wherever no dark fuel exists. Applied to 3 (plant, class) rows: 55088 CC_CHP (350 MW) and CT_CHP (165 MW) 8.3465 -> 6.9573 (-16.6 %), 10745 Midland Cogeneration Venture (1,479 MW) 8.8243 -> 8.8160 (-0.09 %). Against a byte-identical same-HEAD control: CC_CHP +0.3575/+0.2718/+0.5190 TWh and CT_CHP +0.2197/+0.2218/+0.2240 TWh, displacing CC_REGULAR, imports and COAL_PRB -- the correctly-priced cogen now runs where it should -- at max zonal |dLMP| 0.0491/0.0390/0.0752 $/MWh, under the 0.10 pre-registered bar in all three years. Every criterion verdict is UNCHANGED (12/12 free, 16/16 all, the same single C7 COAL_PRB shape FAIL). Promoted on structural fidelity under rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE], never on a score, and it also closes a reproducibility seam: the predecessor keeper solved on the pre-gate artifact and stopped being reproducible from HEAD once the corrected input landed. Two dark-fuel plants outside MISO (NYISO 2493 East River, NEISO 1595 Kendall) are handed to their own lanes -- no parameter crosses an ISO boundary (rule 25).

INHERITED FROM THE PREDECESSOR KEEPER 2026-08-03-miso-117b-ct-heat, still carried and still true: MISO's CT_PEAKER fleet is priced on its OWN measured CAMPD loaded heat rates instead of eGRID's plant-average annual estimate -- 86 plants / 19,120.7 MW = 85.8 % of class capacity, zero rows excluded by the physical band, zero fitted parameters (rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]). It fixes a measured +9.9..+11.1 % over-pricing of the class at MISO's overnight trough (miso-115 §4, re-audited intact by miso-116). Against a same-HEAD zero-delta control: CT_PEAKER 15.468/19.838/19.088 -> 14.235/18.828/17.862 TWh -- it runs LESS, refuting the prereg's own prediction, because the re-price is capacity-weighted cheaper (-0.393 MMBtu/MWh) but generation-weighted slightly DEARER (+0.003): the cheap plants barely run. Every criterion verdict is unchanged (C1 16/16 free 12/12, C3c bit-identical, C8 PASS under the 0.15 peaker cap despite the h14-21 CT floor becoming load-bearing at +46.9 % forced energy, reproducing miso-107's +47 %). C7 CT_PEAKER cv_ratio improves in all three years (0.981/0.836/0.799 -> 1.219/0.917/1.042); C7 COAL_PRB -- the standing failing criterion -- gets marginally WORSE (0.466/0.475/0.314 -> 0.462/0.474/0.309) and is kept per rules 1/14 rather than reverting an accurate input. Promoted on structural fidelity under an explicit owner override of the prereg's own promotion blocker. Determination NOT-YET on the same C7 COAL_PRB shape issue; ledgered caveats unchanged at 2/3: C3a, C3c.

MISO holds no holdout marker and has spent no holdout year, so there is no touchpoint to retain. miso-155 is KEPT because it is the post-keeper run that is NOT a rejected mechanism: it armed nothing and minted no cell verdict, but it CLOSED the lane's standing instrument blocker (the P0 commitment record read exactly, the missing reliability-floor registry found: CT_PEAKER residual -13.91/-8.66/-5.53 % -> -0.89/-0.26/-0.52 %), which is the live state of the MISO lane. THIRTEEN RUNS PRUNED. Pre-keeper: 2026-08-04-miso-122b-scope-gate, 2026-08-04-miso-124-dualfuel-rearm, 2026-08-04-miso-126-steampart-b, 2026-08-04-miso-126-steampart-control, 2026-08-04-miso-127-onlinepmin, 2026-08-04-miso-127-onlinepmin-control, 2026-08-05-miso-132b-cc-committed, 2026-08-05-miso-132b-control, 2026-08-07-miso-133-taxgs-arm, 2026-08-07-miso-133-taxgs-control, and 2026-08-09-miso-148-control (the keeper's own A/B control). REJECTED WHOLESALE AFTER THE KEEPER, and pruned on that ground: 2026-08-11-miso-151-control and 2026-08-11-miso-151-offer-surface -- queue item 9's MISO measured_offer_surface, 'chartered, built, solved, REGISTERED and REJECTED' at miso-151, cell U -> R, refused although the arm improved both failing gates (C3a-2025 -15.6 -> -14.9 %, C3b-2025 0.212 -> 0.207) because its identification was refuted by the session's own G-1/G-5 measurements. It offered no admissible new mechanism toward C3a/C3b, which is exactly the class of run this directive removes. 2026-08-05-miso-132b-cc-committed (the predecessor keeper) and the miso-151 pair are cited in this file and in the matrix; those citations now dangle by design.
